warnings: These values are saved recipes only and must not trigger robot motion without an explicitly authorized pick/place workflow.
Grip and release values were supplied from physical tests; verify payload retention and collision clearance before autonomous use.

rules: Every frozen part must carry detector-generated median quality metrics.
A complete count never overrides a low-confidence or malformed mask.
Any quality failure blocks snapshot creation and forces a fresh tray measurement.
